name: Norwegian Fjords Expedition
description: Towering cliffs and crystal waters carve nature's masterpiece. Cruise through breathtaking fjords beneath snow-capped peaks. Discover charming Nordic villages steeped in timeless traditions. An unforgettable journey into the heart of Scandinavia's wilderness.

name: Santorini – Aegean Dreams
description: Whitewashed villages cascading down volcanic cliffs above the Aegean Sea. World-famous sunsets paint the horizon in shades of gold and crimson. Luxury, romance, and timeless Greek charm at every turn.

name: Italian Grand Tour
description: Rome's ruins at golden hour, a Tuscan hill town where the wine list is the neighbour's vineyard, and an Amalfi coast road that makes you grip the seat and not regret it. Ten days built around what Italy actually tastes and feels like.

name: Swiss Alpine Wonderland
description: Towering peaks and emerald valleys frame every moment. Ride legendary mountain railways through clouds and into the heart of the Alps. A journey built for wonder.

name: Japan – Land of Contrasts
description: Asakusa's temple bells before the crowds arrive, a bullet train that turns Kyoto into Tokyo's next-door neighbour, and a Fukuoka yatai stall that isn't in any guidebook. Nine days paced to what Japan is actually like.

name: Bali – Island of the Gods
description: Rice terraces at sunrise before the tour buses arrive, a family temple ceremony you're invited into rather than photographing from outside, and a coastline built for doing absolutely nothing well.

name: Bhutan - Paro & Thimphu
description: Bhutan caps the number of tourists it lets in every year, and it shows — no billboards, no traffic jams, and a monastery clinging to a cliff face that looks unreal until you're standing in front of it. This is the only country that measures Gross National Happiness instead of GDP, and the pace of this trip reflects that philosophy.

name: Nepal - Kathmandu & Pokhara
description: Nepal compresses the Himalaya's scale into a trip that doesn't require technical trekking experience — Kathmandu's temple-dense old town, Pokhara's lakeside calm with the Annapurna range as backdrop, and an early-morning mountain flight that gets you eye-level with Everest without the multi-week trek.

name: Sri Lanka
description:
This trip traces Sri Lanka along two threads at once: the Ramayana trail linking ancient temples across the island's west, north, and east, and the cultural triangle's UNESCO landmarks at Sigiriya, Dambulla, and Kandy. It runs coast to coast and up into hill country, closing in Colombo's colonial-era streets.

Best for travelers who want mythology and pilgrimage sites alongside Sri Lanka's most famous ruins, temples, and tea country.

name: South Korea
description:
South Korea moves between two speeds: the packed, neon rhythm of Seoul and the slower pace of the southeast, where Joseon-era villages, royal tombs, and coastal fish markets set the tone. This trip runs Seoul to the DMZ, then south through Andong and Gyeongju's temple towns, ending on the harbor in Busan, tied together by the KTX bullet train so a five-hour distance feels like a short hop.

Best for travelers who want the capital's scale and street life alongside Korea's older, quieter historical core.

name: Andaman Islands
description:
This trip covers the Andaman Islands' three main hubs in six nights, from Port Blair's wartime history to Havelock's blue-flag beaches and Neil Island's coral-formed bridges, moving by ferry between islands with a mix of relaxation, snorkeling, and water sports built in.

Best for travelers who want beach time, water activities, and a touch of colonial-era history in one island-hopping trip.

name: Iceland
description:
Iceland’s Ring Road in a single trip, running from Reykjavik’s geothermal lagoon along the south coast’s black sand beaches and waterfalls, past glacier lagoons, and up to the northern lakes before swinging back via the Snæfellsnes peninsula. Whale watching, glacier boats, and volcanic landscapes fill most days.

Best for travelers who want dramatic landscapes and nature-led days over city sightseeing.

name: South Africa
description:
This trip covers South Africa from coast to bushveld: Cape Town’s mountain and peninsula, the Garden Route lagoon at Knysna, ostrich country around Oudtshoorn, the resort city of Sun City, and a safari in Kruger National Park, with a flight linking the south coast to Johannesburg.

Best for travelers who want city sightseeing, scenic coastline, and a Big 5 safari in a single trip, with Indian meals throughout.

name: Kenya & Tanzania
description:
This trip crosses two countries on one safari circuit, starting in Kenya with the Mount Kenya foothills, Lake Nakuru, and the Masai Mara, then crossing the border at Isebania into Tanzania for the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Manyara, and Tarangire. It covers most of East Africa’s best-known game reserves in a single overland route.

Best for travelers who want a long, wildlife-led safari across both Kenya and Tanzania, with the Great Migration’s home territory at its center.
